messages:
Carmen L: Quick heads-up — planning a small "terraform compatibility fuzing" session next Tue 10am PT to hammer on partner ref-arch modules across providers and edge hw. Goal: surface provider-plugin/version, module inputs, and marketplace packaging flakes.
Juan P: love the name, lol. what's the plan? manual runs or automated matrix?
Carmen L: automated matrix. we'll spin GH runners + a tiny Ampere spot pool for hardware-specific cases. short checklist: module smoke, provider pinning, `init`/`apply` dry-run, and plan-json validation.
Alex R: I can add a GH Action that iterates over a matrix of providers and terraform versions. something like: 
```yaml
name: terraform-fuzz
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  fuzz:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        provider: [aws, gcp, oci]
        tf_version: [1.3.9, 1.4.6, 1.5.0]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./scripts/fuzz-terraform.sh --module examples/refkit --provider ${{ matrix.provider }} --tf ${{ matrix.tf_version }}
```
Maya S: Add a check that module outputs are stable (hash of outputs) and a lightweight policy test for marketplace metadata (license, docs, tags).
Priya (partner-eng): We'll bring two partner modules: 'gpu-serving-refkit' and 'vpc-secure-starter'. I can pre-seed some env vars for creds. also want a smoke test for KMS integration in private deployments.
Carmen L: perfect. Juan — can you own the Ampere spot pool config? I want a tiny cluster with 2x A10 instances to reproduce quantization/placement issues.
Juan P: yep, will provision and post the kube/ssh creds to the secure channel. ETA Monday EOD.
Alex R: note for runners — set `TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` and pin provider checksums in `required_providers` to catch mismatches. also set `TF_IN_AUTOMATION=1` to avoid prompts.
Maya S: Suggest adding a short conformance script that validates marketplace zip layout: `manifest.yaml`, `modules/`, `examples/`, `LICENSE`. if it fails, GH status should block merge.
Carmen L: action items: Alex - GH Action + fuzz script improvements; Juan - Ampere pool + creds; Priya - partner modules + sample inputs; Maya - marketplace conformance script. I'll create a calendar invite and a short runbook.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "TF compatibility fuzing — partners" Tue 10:00 PT — invitees: Carmen L, Juan P, Alex R, Maya S, Priya (partner-eng).
Priya (partner-eng): thanks — I'll also prepare a minimal repro that shows provider version skew causing `plan` diff on nested modules.
Carmen L: great. keep notes in the refkit repo under `./tests/fuzzing/` so we can turn failures into CI flaky tickets. :thumbsup:
Alex R: ack. I'll open the proto action PR today and tag this thread.
Maya S: ack — will sketch the conformance script and add a README for partners.
Juan P: will post creds link once provisioned.
Carmen L: cool, that's all for now. see you Tuesday — bring coffee and patience. :coffee:
